verdict.rationale: Conductor documents choosing between an API key and a subscription for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor in cloud agent connections, and its pricing promises "bring your own subscriptions and keys", so model-provider auth can use API keys instead of subscription logins. However, the evidence shows only short changelog and pricing mentions. Nothing shows that Conductor itself, or its API, can be accessed with an API key instead of an account login. Missing for 10: evidence of API-key authentication to Conductor's own account and API rather than account/GitHub sign-in, in-depth setup docs for API-key mode (local as well as cloud), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can authenticate with an API key instead of an account login
